briefdescription.para: Allocates an AVEncryptionInfo structure and sub-pointers to hold the given number of subsamples.

detaileddescription.para: This will allocate pointers for the key ID, IV, and subsample entries, set the size members, and zero-initialize the rest.

parameterdescription.para: The number of bytes in the key ID, should be 16.
The number of bytes in the IV, should be 16.

simplesect.para: The new AVEncryptionInfo structure, or NULL on error.

briefdescription.para: Allocates an AVEncryptionInfo structure with a copy of the given data.

simplesect.para: The new AVEncryptionInfo structure, or NULL on error.

briefdescription.para: Frees the given encryption info object.

detaileddescription.para: This MUST NOT be used to free the side-data data pointer, that should use normal side-data methods.

briefdescription.para: Creates a copy of the AVEncryptionInfo that is contained in the given side data.

detaileddescription.para: The resulting object should be passed to av_encryption_info_free() when done.

simplesect.para: The new AVEncryptionInfo structure, or NULL on error.

briefdescription.para: Allocates and initializes side data that holds a copy of the given encryption info.

detaileddescription.para: The resulting pointer should be either freed using av_free or given to av_packet_add_side_data().

simplesect.para: The new side-data pointer, or NULL.

memberdef.argsstring: (uint32_t system_id_size, uint32_t num_key_ids, uint32_t key_id_size, uint32_t data_size)

briefdescription.para: Allocates an AVEncryptionInitInfo structure and sub-pointers to hold the given sizes.
